newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable on U.S. enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable on U.S. enquiries.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in slow late trading on Tuesday on the back of fresh U.S. enquiries, dealers said.

"The market remains slow, despite fresh enquiries from the U.S. We, however, expect deals to be done later today at least at 54.50 cents in Medan," one dealer in the north Sumatran city of Medan said.
Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November were at 55.00-55.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 54.50-55.00 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.25-54.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said SIR3CV was on offer at 140 cents/kg, down from the previous 151 cents, but few deals were heard.
They said SIR3CV was last traded at 145 cents/kg for November deliveries.
One latex dealer in Medan said he expected to ship around 1,500 tonnes of wet latex to the United States in October at prices done between 90 to 91 cents/kg.
Latex for October shipments was last traded at 90 cents/kg fob Medan for Europe.
